slices.summary: Records the layered browser policy (DEC-19), server-bound browser ids (DEC-20), the org-core site store and read-only Ask mode in the decisions ledger and the ownership matrix, and fixes the agent-browser drift in the Quarry cross-plane doc and the orchestrator-core README. Adds the canonical browser-domain golden with accept and reject vectors; docs and fixture only, no runtime change.

slices.title: Browser Do tools offered only when scoped
slices.summary: Moves browser.observe and browser.act out of the always-offered Do catalogue into browser_tool_defs(), offering them only when a verified browser bearer is present, the run is not ZDR and the flag is on, and makes the purge-lock refuse stray browser.* calls. Behind EXECUTION_DO_BROWSER_ENABLED (default off); rollback is a revert.
slices.flag: EXECUTION_DO_BROWSER_ENABLED, default off; only the value 1 enables it; compose default ${EXECUTION_DO_BROWSER_ENABLED:-0} in the execution-core block

slices.title: Forward browser bearer on flagged Do runs
slices.summary: Adds a BFF browser_token() that mints the browser bearer only when the run's tool set offers browser.* (flag on, site policy not all-deny, Space browser_entitled; K3-24), never for agentic turns generally and never under ZDR. model-gateway forwards it to execution-core, where RunAgent authenticates it and keeps it in LoopContext.browser_bearer (None for child contexts); metadata only, no proto change.
slices.flag: BROWSER_DO_ENABLED (BFF) and the execution-core flag EXECUTION_DO_BROWSER_ENABLED, both default off

slices.title: Org-core browser site policy store and API
slices.summary: Adds the org-core browser-site policy of record: org_browser_site_policy (open or allowlist mode, revision), org_browser_site_rules (block, read or act per host), user_browser_site_prefs (200 per user, expires_at defaulting to 90 days), and an append-only org_browser_site_history, with RLS by org. Adds an internal resolve endpoint returning deny, ask, read or act with source and revision, plus admin and user APIs with expected_revision checks (409 on conflict); no caller until S4.
slices.needs_external: Control Plane owner for principals: the browser-broker principal in plane-service-principals.json and the compose principals needs its own PR per principal batch (K1-12); coordinate the shared service_auth.go, server.go and migration numbering with WS10-S2

slices.title: Broker AcquireGrant consults org-core site policy
slices.summary: Adds a fail-closed org-core resolve client to the browser broker (2 s timeout, positive cache up to 30 s, refuse when org-core is down) and makes AcquireGrant for run grants intersect requested domains with what the policy allows at that level; an empty result is PermissionDenied with denied_domains, capped at the start host plus 8, with read_only and ttl_seconds honoured up to 30 min. browser.proto gains the 4.3 tags (request space_id 10, read_only 11, ttl_seconds 12; response read_only 10, denied_domains 11; validate read_only 10, subject to QRY renumbering).
slices.needs_external: QRY session: Grant v2 note, Quarry-to-broker identity and issuance endpoint; Quarry must reject mutating actions on read_only grants; the Go, Rust and vendored Quarry copies of browser.proto are regenerated by the second lander
slices.flag: BROWSER_BROKER_SITE_POLICY=off|shadow|enforce, default off until S10; an unknown value is treated as enforce (K3-26); BROWSER_GRANT_MAX_TTL default 30 min

slices.title: Do browser open, observe and close on real grants
slices.summary: Adds a BrowserSession in execution-core that resolves policy, acquires a broker grant, starts a Quarry run and navigates, and offers server-bound browser.open, browser.observe and browser.close to the Do loop with no ids in model-visible text. It also releases grants at run end and on cancel, maps browser.open and browser.observe to cap.browser.observe (the legacy browser_agent stays on cap.browser.open), seeds cap.browser.observe (low) and cap.browser.act (medium, starts unavailable) through a new capability-core migration, and attests health only when the broker and Quarry are ready.
slices.needs_external: QRY session: Quarry-to-broker identity, grant issuance and require_browser_grants; the run owner equals the grant owner is assumed from QRY, not decided; DEC-02 credential-window owner for the bearer margin
slices.flag: EXECUTION_DO_BROWSER_ENABLED together with BROWSER_BROKER_SITE_POLICY=enforce; browser.act is not offered in this slice

slices.title: Do browser act with risk gate and site consent
slices.summary: Adds browser.act{action} behind a risk classifier over wire actions: read-level grants refuse act before any call, risky acts pause for approval with a typed cause, and a site that needs consent raises browser_site_consent clamped to the grant cap. act must not be enabled until the Quarry read_only contract test (K3-6) proves mutating actions are refused on read grants.
slices.needs_external: QRY session: Quarry contract test proving read_only grants refuse mutating actions (K3-6); WS13 must accept the browser_site_consent and browser_action_risk causes (once or remember scope options for this code); WS26 screening before or with this slice (audit L1714)
slices.flag: same as S5a (EXECUTION_DO_BROWSER_ENABLED with BROWSER_BROKER_SITE_POLICY=enforce); browser.act stays off until the Quarry read_only contract test passes (K3-6)
